c1_integration.state_root_addition: Optional keyword-only state_root selects the receipt-bound managed manifest; omitted calls retain offline/legacy release-manifest behavior.
c1_integration.writer_lease: The C1 WriterLease is borrowed through C1LeaseAdapter; no unlock/reacquire occurs inside the transaction.

d_boundary.no_shared_write_assumption: D component paths are disjoint. Any later edit to C2 lifecycle/recovery/C1 execution files requires a new admitted integration step rather than concurrent ownership.
d_boundary.required_d_action: D re-applies its registration source onto the landed C2 base, preserving the adopt-unowned planning keyword, the rebind verb, and non-refusing terminal inspection, then revalidates its fixed registration operations under the same held C1 lease.
d_boundary.supported_by_c2: artifact operations only across the fixed five units

cli.adoption_flag: --adopt-unowned selects byte-identical unowned artifact adoption for upgrade and rollback only

execute_operation.signature: execute_operation(kind, release_root, state_root, payload_root, opencode_root, *, maintenance_window_confirmed=<default>, adopt_unowned=<default>, receipt_id=<default>, transaction_id=<default>, now=<default>, probe=<default>, recovery_command_sink=<default>, _preparation_failpoint=<default>)

publish_and_execute.signature: publish_and_execute(bundle, lease, c1_inspect, registration_snapshot, *, now=<default>, probe=<default>)

normal_planner.pending_status: status returns a validated recovery_required transaction, plan digest, current compatible recovery command and recorded interpreter provenance without terminal ownership certification

preparation_reconciliation.rule: Under the C1 lease, reserved paths are bound to stable created identities before writes, promoted only after exact completion, and reconciled according to phase without deleting substitutions or unknown content.

normal_planner.terminal_inspection: inspect_terminal_ownership reports receipt drift as an uncertified installation with a reason string instead of raising; mutation stays strict because an uncertified installation is ineligible for every operation.

publication_limit: This packet binds the C2 source landed on main. It does not claim native qualification, live activation, host restart, or any registration admission.

recovery_executor.mutation_binding: Artifact copy, metadata replacement, unit rename and bounded stage removal use opened no-follow descriptors; directories use stable device/inode/type tokens while files retain full tokens.

python_contract.recorded_path_and_version: diagnostic provenance; a compatible current interpreter may execute the exact copied recoverer
